Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: final still frame for a Chinese news explainer, 9:16 vertical image-to-video reference.
Create the main scene showing two black-and-white halftone medical researchers examining a paper study report beside a microscope and laboratory bench in the middle core. Establish a clinical research context without showing the final result yet..
Premium editorial halftone paper collage, warm cream flat paper field filling the whole vertical frame, black-and-white halftone cut-outs, teal research cards and mustard yellow cardstock accents, cream keylines, subtle paper grain and soft shadows. Full frame composition with secondary collage scraps and halftone texture near edges. Keep the researchers, study report and microscope in the middle; the top is a news headline safe area with only secondary texture, no essential information.
Use only the short Chinese label “研究发现” on the report, perfectly legible..
The visual must communicate a research finding rather than a guaranteed medical cure. No miracle claim, no before-and-after body transformation, no patient photo.
No extra text, cold rice bowls, numeric promises, no English, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no subtitles, no 3D.
